name: Understand Anything Viewer
copyright: Copyright (c) 2026 Yuxiang Lin, Infinite Universe, Inc.
description: Interactive knowledge graph viewer for code architecture. Used in this plugin with Human Layout patch applied and served through a host-side HTML wrapper / fetch shim instead of a second source patch.

patches.description: Human Layout improvements: bypass containers for ≤20 nodes, compact ELK, hover dimming, keyboard focus, dark contrast

SUPERSEDED. Hana plugin integration is now performed at runtime by routes/viewer.js and assets/app.js: HTML wrapper rewrites asset URLs, injects a fetch shim for the six UA data requests, adds the pluginSurfaceSession header, and seeds sessionStorage to skip TokenGate. The standalone adapter patch is kept as a historical placeholder only and must not be applied to the source.

distSha256Description: Deterministic SHA-256 over the entire locked asset set (sorted path|size|sha256 lines), stored as manifest.assetSetSha256. Not just index.html.
upgradePolicy: Evaluate upstream releases for schema/API changes. Regenerate assets/ua/viewer/manifest.json with scripts/pack-ua-assets.mjs after repacking and update this distSha256 to match manifest.assetSetSha256. If the Human Layout patch can apply cleanly and the wrapper/shim contract still holds, upgrade; otherwise freeze at this version.
